name: Blender MCP Plus
description: MCP server for Blender: official Blender Lab tools + Poly Haven asset library
long_description:
Blender MCP Plus gives an LLM client natural-language access to a running Blender instance. It includes the official Blender Lab tool set (code execution, scene inspection, Python API and manual search, screenshots, headless Blender) plus a Poly Haven asset library bridge (`search_assets` / `import_asset`) for free CC0 models, HDRIs and textures.

An official Blender add-on is required: install `mcp-1.0.3.zip` from https://projects.blender.org/lab/blender_mcp/releases and enable the `MCP` add-on in Blender 5.1 or newer.
